prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE portrait art-direction board for the Korean first-person writing cafe "쓰는 인간". This is a generated atmosphere proposal, not an actual application screenshot.
Primary request: make someone want to return to a familiar private writing cafe for its changing light, subtle environmental sounds, and a personal place waiting for them.
Composition: 1024x1536 portrait board, three broad landscape scenes stacked vertically with slim ivory gutters. Exactly the SAME cafe, SAME seated first-person camera, SAME desk and objects in every scene, to make the changes in atmosphere clear. The scene should occupy most of each panel. Restrained small Korean typography; no interface controls.
Setting: a walnut writing desk beside a broad clear window and a generously wide glazed garden door. Through the window is the SAME modest enclosed garden: one small tree, a few simple seasonal flowers, a little pond with two tiny goldfish, low stone edging and a garden lantern. Generous walkways. A suggestion of the central communal table beyond. Warm walnut wall panels, lime plaster, matte dark taupe stone floor. On the personal desk: open ivory notebook, a slender graphite pencil, bookmarked page, ivory ceramic tea cup and saucer, shaded brass-and-walnut desk lamp, one small vase with a restrained flower stem. All objects remain in place between panels.
Style: refined clear stylized 3D game environment, subtly watercolor-painted materials, rounded crafted furniture. Believable human scale, simple achievable geometry, crisp silhouettes and readable wood/stone/paper. Do not make a photograph or a photorealistic luxury interior. No blurred lens, bloom veil or fog.
Panel 1: late-afternoon filtered daylight, gentle moving-leaf shadow suggested on the desk and stone floor, lively but quiet garden. Foreground remains readable.
Panel 2: dusk, warm desk lamp visibly pools light onto the notebook, very restrained tea steam, soft amber edge light outside, garden lantern beginning to glow.
Panel 3: after a light evening rain: a few droplets on the clear glass, leaves and pond with small drip ripples, cool blue garden against the warm intimate lamp. Preserve the visible garden and legibility of the desk; no crushed blacks, no dense rain curtain. This is an inviting place to sit quietly, even without writing.
Brand: personal, literary, calm, understated, warm ink brown and ivory, walnut and muted sage, restrained cool outdoor blues. No people, hands or avatar. No visitor simulation, rewards, streaks, shopping, neon, floating interaction icons or bottom controls.
Text, verbatim Korean: at the top small "쓰는 인간", heading "같은 자리, 다른 하루". Under panel 1: "오후의 창가 · 잎이 스치는 소리". Under panel 2: "해 질 무렵 · 찻잔이 놓이는 소리". Under panel 3: "비가 그친 밤 · 처마에서 떨어지는 빗방울". At the bottom small "분위기 시안 · 앱 반영 전". No other readable text. Keep the Korean text clear and modest, not oversized.
One cohesive art-direction board, not three alternate cafe designs.
proposed_additions: Gradual daylight, leaf shadows and warm lamp transitions while staying
Position- and doorway-dependent environmental sound with a remembered personal mix
Explicit playback of a personally selected written sentence
scope_note: The existing application already supports selected day/dusk/rain moods, rain/water loops, item sounds, personal seating and a personal sentence frame. These proposals extend those features rather than claiming they are new.
